qualifying_updates.source_title: AI coding agents fall for malicious instructions planted in the Downloads folder
qualifying_updates.source_type: public security-news report of researcher findings
qualifying_updates.short_factual_summary: The report says a silently downloaded AGENTS.md can be treated as trusted instructions if a coding agent is opened in the Downloads directory. It describes a test in which the file attempted a package installation and, in a related configuration-path example, credential exposure.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Instruction files must have a provenance boundary: an agent should not execute from download or copied-worktree locations until instruction files are inventoried, reviewed, and treated as untrusted input. Package installation and configuration changes requested by repository guidance need a separately visible approval and evidence trail.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing_note: Route product-specific behavior and vulnerability tracking to the upstream AI or security wiki; retain only the local instruction-provenance, working-directory, package-install, and approval practice.
qualifying_updates.source_reliability_note: Contemporary secondary report that attributes findings to Forever Security researchers; ingest should seek the primary research or vendor advisory before making product-specific claims durable.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_notes: Compare with prompt-injection-and-untrusted-content and instruction-hierarchy-and-artifact-boundaries. Preserve the report's attribution and do not generalize one product test into universal behavior.

qualifying_updates.source_title: Git as the Control Plane for AI Agent Definitions
qualifying_updates.short_factual_summary: The article proposes treating agent definitions, permission scopes, tool lists, and budgets as versioned configuration subject to pull-request review and CI validation. It distinguishes a reviewed configuration record from runtime evidence, recommending that every run identify the exact approved configuration commit.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Teams need a control-plane/data-plane split: instructions can guide work, but external enforcement must bound permissions, tools, and budgets. Reviewable configuration, schema and prohibited-pattern checks, and configuration-to-run linkage make delegated actions attributable without claiming that model behavior itself is deterministic.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing_note: Route broad specification, runtime, and vendor coverage upstream. A local synthesis may retain only the configuration-review, enforcement, and provenance pattern.
qualifying_updates.source_reliability_note: Current practitioner analysis with linked papers; the operating pattern is a proposal, not a standard or an independently verified product release.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_notes: Compare with commit-level-ai-governance, agent-governance-infrastructure, and instruction-hierarchy-and-artifact-boundaries. Validate linked research before citing its quantitative claims.

qualifying_updates.source_title: Enforcing Hard Spend Limits Before a Coding Agent Session Resumes Not After It Ends
qualifying_updates.short_factual_summary: The article describes a reserve-execute-commit pattern that checks and reserves budget before a model or tool action, and proposes a read-only resume phase that rechecks authority, budget, credentials, rate limits, and blockers before a paused agent can produce another side effect.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Post-hoc usage dashboards are insufficient for autonomous or resumed work. A durable harness should use pre-action controls for model, tool, retry, token, and spend limits; checkpoint state; and emit a decision record that links the permit-or-deny result to the attempted action.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing_note: No ecosystem entity coverage is retained; this is a local harness and operating-control implication.
qualifying_updates.source_reliability_note: Current practitioner analysis. Its named company anecdotes and regulatory discussion require primary-source verification before durable citation.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_notes: Compare with agent-session-recovery, agent-harness-components, governance-controls-for-agents, and persistent-agent-workspaces. Separate a generic pre-action control pattern from any unverified implementation or regulatory claim.
